_about: TrackPoli WCAG 2.2 A/AA conformance record, updated for TP1-03 (adds the password-recovery screens: forgot-password request, check-your-email, set-new-password, and the shared /auth/confirm Continue page with its continue/expired/error states) on top of the TP1-02 sign-in surfaces. pass-manual verdicts are agent static reviews of the markup, CSS and ARIA of those screens; a full human keyboard + screen-reader audit of the real screens is scheduled for P1-16 (NFR-A1). Colour is deliberately grayscale for now (ADR-0006), so contrast criteria are re-verified when the brand colour lands. Regenerate per surface as more screens land.

1.1.1.note: Icons (Icon component) are decorative with empty alt (brand mark, warning, clock, mail, error, back chevron, requirement check/dot); the brand mark sits beside the text 'TrackPoli Admin'. The recovery email's logo is a hosted PNG with empty alt beside the wordmark. No informational image lacks a text alternative.
1.1.1.reviewer: agent static review of the TP1-02 sign-in + TP1-03 recovery screens (pending human a11y audit in P1-16)

1.3.1.note: Native <label for> binds each field (TextField), the form has an accessible name (aria-labelledby), helper text is wired via aria-describedby, and the error banner is a real region; structure conveyed semantically, not by presentation.
1.3.1.reviewer: agent static review of the TP1-02 sign-in + TP1-03 recovery screens (pending human a11y audit in P1-16)

1.3.2.reviewer: agent static review of the TP1-02 sign-in + TP1-03 recovery screens (pending human a11y audit in P1-16)

1.3.4.note: Layout is not locked to an orientation (responsive CSS, no transform-based rotation lock).
1.3.4.reviewer: agent static review of the TP1-02 sign-in + TP1-03 recovery screens (pending human a11y audit in P1-16)

1.3.3.note: No instructions relying on sensory characteristics (shape, size, position, sound).

1.3.5.note: Email uses autoComplete='username' + inputMode='email'; password uses autoComplete='current-password', so the input purpose is programmatically identified.
1.3.5.reviewer: agent static review of the TP1-02 sign-in + TP1-03 recovery screens (pending human a11y audit in P1-16)

1.4.1.note: The failed-sign-in state is conveyed by banner text + a warning icon + aria-invalid + helper text, never by colour alone.
1.4.1.reviewer: agent static review of the TP1-02 sign-in + TP1-03 recovery screens (pending human a11y audit in P1-16)

1.4.3.note: Grayscale MD3 tokens; text/background pairings inspected against 4.5:1 (normal) / 3:1 (large). Re-verified when the brand colour replaces the grayscale token values (ADR-0006).
1.4.3.reviewer: agent static review of the TP1-02 sign-in + TP1-03 recovery screens (pending human a11y audit in P1-16)

1.4.4.note: Type scale uses relative units; content reflows and remains usable at 200% zoom.
1.4.4.reviewer: agent static review of the TP1-02 sign-in + TP1-03 recovery screens (pending human a11y audit in P1-16)

1.4.5.note: No images of text; the brand name and all copy are real text.

1.4.10.note: Single-column card layout reflows to a 320px viewport with no two-dimensional scrolling.
1.4.10.reviewer: agent static review of the TP1-02 sign-in + TP1-03 recovery screens (pending human a11y audit in P1-16)

1.4.11.note: Text-field outlines, button surfaces, the error outline and the focus ring were inspected for >=3:1 contrast against their adjacent colours.
1.4.11.reviewer: agent static review of the TP1-02 sign-in + TP1-03 recovery screens (pending human a11y audit in P1-16)

1.4.12.reviewer: agent static review of the TP1-02 sign-in + TP1-03 recovery screens (pending human a11y audit in P1-16)

1.4.13.note: No content is revealed on hover or focus (the password toggle swaps the input type in place; it shows no new overlay).

2.1.1.note: All controls are native elements (input, button, anchor): the form, the password visibility toggle, the Google and Sign in buttons and the Forgot password link are fully keyboard-operable.
2.1.1.reviewer: agent static review of the TP1-02 sign-in + TP1-03 recovery screens (pending human a11y audit in P1-16)

2.1.2.note: No custom focus management; nothing traps the keyboard (native controls only, no modal).
2.1.2.reviewer: agent static review of the TP1-02 sign-in + TP1-03 recovery screens (pending human a11y audit in P1-16)

2.2.1.note: The only time limit is the account lockout pause, which is an essential security control (WCAG 2.2.1 'Essential' exception); extending it would defeat the brute-force protection.

2.2.2.note: No moving, blinking, scrolling or auto-updating content.

2.4.1.note: Single content region; no repeated blocks of navigation to bypass yet (shell nav arrives in P1-12).

2.4.2.note: Each route sets a descriptive document title via Next metadata.
2.4.2.reviewer: agent static review of the TP1-02 sign-in + TP1-03 recovery screens (pending human a11y audit in P1-16)

2.4.3.note: DOM order matches visual order (email, password + toggle, forgot link, Google, Sign in); no tabindex re-ordering.
2.4.3.reviewer: agent static review of the TP1-02 sign-in + TP1-03 recovery screens (pending human a11y audit in P1-16)

2.4.4.note: The one link ('Forgot password?') has descriptive text that states its purpose.
2.4.4.reviewer: agent static review of the TP1-02 sign-in + TP1-03 recovery screens (pending human a11y audit in P1-16)

2.4.5.note: Multiple-ways applies across a set of pages; these are single-purpose authentication entry points.

2.4.6.note: Headings (the h1 on each screen) and every field/button label describe their topic or purpose.
2.4.6.reviewer: agent static review of the TP1-02 sign-in + TP1-03 recovery screens (pending human a11y audit in P1-16)

2.4.7.note: A visible focus ring is defined on inputs, buttons, the toggle and the link (no outline:none without a replacement).
2.4.7.reviewer: agent static review of the TP1-02 sign-in + TP1-03 recovery screens (pending human a11y audit in P1-16)

2.4.11.note: No sticky header/footer overlaps a focused control; focused elements remain fully visible within the card.
2.4.11.reviewer: agent static review of the TP1-02 sign-in + TP1-03 recovery screens (pending human a11y audit in P1-16)

2.5.2.note: All actions are on native buttons/links, which activate on pointer-up and can be cancelled by moving off before release.
2.5.2.reviewer: agent static review of the TP1-02 sign-in + TP1-03 recovery screens (pending human a11y audit in P1-16)

2.5.3.note: Visible-text buttons ('Sign in', 'Continue with Google') carry that text as their accessible name; the icon-only password toggle uses an aria-label ('Show password'/'Hide password').
2.5.3.reviewer: agent static review of the TP1-02 sign-in + TP1-03 recovery screens (pending human a11y audit in P1-16)

2.5.8.note: The buttons, the field, the toggle and the link each meet the 24x24 CSS-pixel minimum target size.
2.5.8.reviewer: agent static review of the TP1-02 sign-in + TP1-03 recovery screens (pending human a11y audit in P1-16)

3.1.2.note: No parts in a language other than the page language.

3.2.1.note: Focusing a field or control triggers no change of context (no auto-submit, no navigation on focus).
3.2.1.reviewer: agent static review of the TP1-02 sign-in + TP1-03 recovery screens (pending human a11y audit in P1-16)

3.2.2.note: Typing changes no context; the password toggle is an explicit button press, and submission is an explicit Sign in press.
3.2.2.reviewer: agent static review of the TP1-02 sign-in + TP1-03 recovery screens (pending human a11y audit in P1-16)

3.2.3.note: Consistent navigation applies across a set of pages; the shell navigation arrives in P1-12.

3.2.4.note: No components repeated across multiple pages to identify consistently yet.

3.2.6.note: No help mechanism is present across pages yet (consistent-help applies once one exists).

3.3.1.note: Errors are identified in text and programmatically: the sign-in/recovery Banner (role=alert), plus aria-invalid + aria-describedby helper on fields; the confirm-password field shows an inline 'Both passwords must match.' helper when they differ.
3.3.1.reviewer: agent static review of the TP1-02 sign-in + TP1-03 recovery screens (pending human a11y audit in P1-16)

3.3.2.note: Every field has a visible <label> (TextField). The set-new-password screen states the policy inline next to the fields ('At least 12 characters'), and the request screen labels the email field.
3.3.2.reviewer: agent static review of the TP1-02 sign-in + TP1-03 recovery screens (pending human a11y audit in P1-16)

3.3.3.note: A correction suggestion is deliberately withheld (the generic 'email or password is incorrect') because naming which was wrong would enable account enumeration; this is the WCAG 3.3.3 security exception (ADR-0005).
3.3.3.reviewer: agent static review of the TP1-02 sign-in + TP1-03 recovery screens (pending human a11y audit in P1-16)

3.3.4.note: Sign-in is not a legal, financial or data-submission transaction; no submission to reverse.

3.3.7.note: Single-step sign-in; no information is requested twice in a process.

3.3.8.note: Authentication uses email + password (and Google SSO); the password field allows paste and offers a show/hide toggle, and no cognitive-function test (puzzle, transcription) is imposed.
3.3.8.reviewer: agent static review of the TP1-02 sign-in + TP1-03 recovery screens (pending human a11y audit in P1-16)

4.1.2.note: Native elements provide name/role/value; the toggle exposes aria-pressed, fields expose aria-invalid/aria-describedby.
4.1.2.reviewer: agent static review of the TP1-02 sign-in + TP1-03 recovery screens (pending human a11y audit in P1-16)

4.1.3.note: Status messages use role=alert (the notice Banner on sign-in, forgot-password, and reset) so they are announced without moving focus; the enumeration-safe 'check your email' acknowledgement is a heading+text state change.
4.1.3.reviewer: agent static review of the TP1-02 sign-in + TP1-03 recovery screens (pending human a11y audit in P1-16)
